recognize_zh: 左圖骨髓抹片中數個巨噬細胞的細胞質塞滿粗大深綠褐至黑色顆粒狀包涵體；右圖鐵染色（Prussian blue）這些巨噬細胞內充滿藍綠色粗顆粒，代表鐵儲存增加。噬血現象在此視野中僅能看到可疑的被吞噬小核碎片，並不明確。
features: Left (Romanowsky): several macrophages with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm packed with coarse dark greenish-brown to black globular inclusions
Some macrophages contain small dark round bodies that may represent ingested nuclear material or platelets; unequivocal whole-cell hemophagocytosis is not clearly shown
Background of maturing granulocytes (myelocytes, bands, segmented neutrophils) and erythroid precursors, consistent with regenerating marrow
Right (Prussian blue): macrophages within a particle filled with coarse blue-green iron-positive granules admixed with some golden-brown globules
No blasts increase evident in the fields shown
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a regenerating marrow with maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors. There are increased macrophages with abundant cytoplasm containing coarse dark greenish-brown to black globular inclusions; some contain small dark bodies suspicious for ingested cellular material, although definite hemophagocytosis of intact cells is not unequivocal in this field. A Prussian blue stain of a marrow particle shows macrophages laden with coarse blue-green iron-positive granules admixed with golden-brown pigment, indicating increased storage iron. Findings are consistent with increased marrow iron stores in post-chemotherapy/transfusion setting with macrophage activation; residual pigmented globules that are not clearly iron-positive could reflect hemosiderin of variable staining or other ingested debris, and clinical correlation is recommended.

ddx.vs: Fungal elements appear as septate hyphae or conidia that are GMS/PAS positive and Prussian blue negative, whereas these globules are coarse, variably iron-positive and lack hyphal structures.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain blue-green granules that are Prussian blue negative and PAS/Sudan black positive, whereas these macrophages show strong iron staining.
HLH requires convincing macrophage ingestion of intact erythrocytes, leukocytes or platelets together with clinical criteria, which cannot be established from this field alone.
Storage cells have striated or foamy cytoplasm rather than discrete coarse dark pigment globules.
